description: Test suite for group runtime loading and related functionalities in groups.js, using vitest testing framework.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test case by resetting plugin runtime state and module cache.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for 'group runtime loading'.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for verifying group runtime behavior.

methods.name: resetPluginRuntimeStateForTest
methods.description: Resets the plugin runtime state to ensure clean environment for tests.

methods.name: groupsRuntimeLoads
methods.description: Mock function to track whether groups runtime module is loaded.

methods.name: groups.buildGroupChatContext
methods.description: Builds chat context string for a group based on session context.

methods.name: groups.buildGroupIntro
methods.description: Builds an introduction string for a group chat based on configuration.

methods.name: groups.resolveGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Resolves whether a mention is required in a given group context.
